name: html-to-png
description: Renders one local HTML file to a PNG or JPEG image with a real browser engine

scripts.check:chromium: node --input-type=module -e "const { check } = await import('../lib/browser-runtime/browser-runtime.js'); const c = await check(); if (!c.chromiumLaunch) { console.error(c.remediation || 'chromiumLaunch:false'); process.exit(1); } console.log(JSON.stringify(c));"
